title: Negative evaluation of a DNF
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $n$. The value of $\varphi$ at $x$ is $-1$ if and only if at least one term of $\varphi$ evaluates to $-1$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates
